name: 080.1 — a gob is one object, and it looks like one
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 080.1: gob:scale(k) and gob:overlay():add(key) are writes on the OBJECT, so they land in every live session that holds it and the read-back agrees; gob:sessions() names who was walked; the range refusal still names the range. The undo is two-phase and manual, because the addon that wrote is gone by the time there is anything to check.
